derivation.max_abs_currency_net_leverage: family cap 57.5 % of the concentration policy (tools/strategy_farm/config/concentration_tail_limits.v1.json, OWNER_RATIFIED 2026-09-13) applied to the gross ceiling: 0.575 x 7.5 = 4.3125 -> 4.3. A currency bucket aggregates several symbols (EUR = EURUSD + EURGBP + GDAXI), so the family cap, not the symbol cap, is the matching ratio. Headroom over the measured peak (2.80x): 1.54x.
derivation.max_gross_leverage: 25 % margin utilisation at the Darwinex swing profile 1:30 (FX) = 0.25 x 30 = 7.5x notional/equity. Cross-checks: 2.37x the measured live peak (3.16x) and 48 % of the modelled all-24-sleeves-in capacity (15.48x), so it can only be reached by a state at least twice as concentrated as anything the live book has produced. CAVEAT: the 1:30 / 1:15 swing margins are recorded UNVERIFIED (docs/ops/OPEN_ITEMS_STATUS.md 2026-09-05, Darwinex trading-symbols URL 404 on 2026-09-04); OWNER must confirm the account leverage before signing.
derivation.max_planned_stop_loss_account: tail rule of the same ratified policy: maximum_fraction_of_daily_limit 0.8 x venue_daily_loss_limit_pct 5.0 = 4.0 % of equity; on the conservative dd_guard_halt_equity basis 0.04 x 91684.30 = 3667.37 -> 3650 USD. Cross-check against the ratified joint-tail model (stop_risk_budget_pct 9.75 / joint_sleeve_divisor 3 = 3.25 % = 2979.74 USD): 1.23x headroom. Breaching it means simultaneously open stops would consume 80 % of the DXZ daily loss limit; the staged response is entry freeze + pending cancel, never a flatten.
derivation.min_free_margin_account: 0.75 x dd_guard_halt_equity = 0.75 x 91684.30 = 68763.22 -> 68750 USD. Even at the worst equity the ratified 10 % book-DD guard tolerates, at most 25 % of equity may be tied up as margin; below that the margin state, not the DD guard, would be the binding control.

review.known_tension: max_planned_stop_loss_account (3650 USD = 4.0 % of the DD-guard floor equity) is BELOW the book's own full deployment budget (9.75 % of equity). A hypothetical all-24-sleeves-in state would breach it. That state has never occurred (max 7 of 24 concurrent in 2.5 months) and freezing entries there is the intended behaviour, but OWNER should confirm the intent before signing.
